content_blocks.heading_text: CAPM Certification Training for Richmond's Project Management Professionals
content_blocks.text:
Richmond's energy sector—anchored by Dominion Energy's substantial operations and the city's role as a hub for utilities management—demands project managers who can navigate complex, mission-critical initiatives with rigor and accountability. The CAPM® (Certified Associate in Project Management) credential validates the foundational competencies that energy, utilities, and other regulated industries in Richmond expect: structured planning, scope control, risk awareness, and stakeholder communication. Whether you work in the Diamond District's rapid redevelopment, VCU Health's operational projects, or the specialty chemicals and trading firms headquartered here, CAPM certification signals to employers that you meet a recognized professional standard and are committed to advancing your career in project leadership.

Granite PM Academy, a PMI Authorized Training Partner, delivers live-virtual CAPM Certification Training that satisfies the contact-hour requirement to sit for the PMI exam. Our instructor-led courses are taught by active certified practitioners who bring real-world experience to every session, ensuring you learn project management principles in context and build confidence before examination day. We work with professionals across the country, flexible scheduling around your Richmond work calendar, and guide you through eligibility requirements and exam registration as part of your path to certification. Your CAPM credential opens doors to higher-responsibility roles and competitive advancement in Richmond's growing project-driven economy.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Richmond

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and formal project management education—but no work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or higher and can complete the required education hours, you qualify. This makes CAPM ideal for career-changers and graduates entering Richmond's Energy & Utilities, Healthcare, and Higher Education sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive course covers all CAPM domains and aligns with PMI standards. Learn on your schedule across multiple sessions; no commute required. You'll study project fundamentals, processes, and tools with active certified practitioners guiding you throughout.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education hours. Pay the associated exam fee to PMI. Our team will guide you through the application process and confirm all documentation meets PMI requirements before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation support to reinforce concepts and build confidence. You'll take the computer-based CAPM exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Study materials and practice resources help you master the content and demonstrate your project management knowledge.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn professional development units by taking courses, attending workshops, or contributing to project management activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible training to keep your credential active and your skills current.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
